body:
Extract the existing position-carrier selector into a shared Study policy so queue-head preparation and position admission no longer import each other. The previous admission export remains an alias, and source-cache ownership and fences remain unchanged.

The registry records the current carrier and admission edges, and explicitly inventories shared namespace markers without assigning ownership of their children. Six namespace owners remain unresolved; the bounded inventory is not a whole-repository census.

The carrier source passed 26 focused tests with two skips; two additional fixture failures reproduced on its unchanged base and were excluded. The integrated mapping passed the registry checker, 20 scoped controls and seven focused Python cases. The later namespace guard passed the checker and two negative-control tests. Independent source review of the carrier and its initial mapping found no actionable issue; namespace guard review is pending. Native position/replay and assembled saved-review to playable-next proof remain required. No hosted CI or installed behavior is claimed.

Integrated head `bfc1b27f` includes current main `6e9d86ba` and preserves the DDL, startup and namespace guards. The full checker and listing, 26 scoped guard controls, and seven carrier/timing cases passed at this head. Independent integration review is pending. The native position and assembled journey gates remain unrun.

Integrated head `7794188f` includes the selected source-removed checker repair on main `05e18cf5`. The registry checker and full listing, 27 scoped controls including the copied checker closure, and seven carrier/timing cases passed. Native position/replay and assembled journey proof remain unrun.
title: Integrate extracted carrier and map position admission
head: codex/completion-t02-carrier-integration
